text:
Lina - Growth Marketing: Kickoff: tiny OSS reference + 4 micro-tutorials (docs + videos). Deliverables: launch post, concise benchmark blurb for marketing, webinar (gated), LP with lead routing, and 6 social variants. Volunteers?
Omar - DevRel: I can handle the tutorials and demo recordings. I'll run a short perf sweep for three configs (local, hosted, quantized). Want numbers presented as "typical dev results" with a reproducibility link.
Priya - Content: I'll write the launch post and craft the social copy. Tone: practical, engineer-oriented. Two headline options: "RefApp Spark: small starter for building LLM features" or "Ship an LLM prototype in under an hour." Which leans better?
Lina - Growth Marketing: I prefer the second for click-through; the first works for docs. Max, can you do hero + one benchmark graphic + a GIF? Need final copy by Thu lunchtime to lock visuals.
Max - Design: Yep. I'll prepare a compact bar chart for median/p95 and a 6s GIF of the quickstart. Prefer copy by Thu 12:00.
June - GrowthOps: Webinar suggestion: Wed Nov 15, 10am PT. Landing form fields: name, email, company, company_size, role, interest-level. Webhook -> HubSpot. Routing rules: company_size>=150 -> AE queue, else community nurture. Also set property "refapp_spark".
Lina - Growth Marketing: Benchmarks: two bullets max. Omar, can you give rounded numbers and a sentence caveat? Keep numbers marketer-friendly (no raw logs).
Omar - DevRel: Draft bullets: local median ~85ms, local p95 ~300ms; hosted median ~120ms, hosted p95 ~420ms. Quantized dedicated config ~2.8x lower per-token cost in our harness. Will add: "Measured on our harness; results may vary."
Priya - Content: Draft social example (X): "Meet RefApp Spark  a tiny OSS starter to build & tune LLM features locally and in the cloud. Try the guide, watch the webinar Nov 15. https://redwood.ai/refapp-spark #oss #llm"
artifact-bot: Artifact published: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/refapp-spark/v0.1/refapp-spark.tar.gz
June - GrowthOps: I'll create the gated LP and test webhook -> HubSpot. Also will add UTM params and a hidden field for "persona" to route drip flows. Calendar invite after 40 registrants.
Lina - Growth Marketing: Owners recap: Omar (tutorials + bench blurbs), Priya (blog + socials), Max (assets), June (webinar + routing). Timeline: draft blog Tue -> review Wed -> assets locked Thu -> publish + webinar Nov 15 AM.
Omar - DevRel: I'll PR the demo repo updates and bench script by Mon EOD. Snippet to include in blog: 
```
python bench.py --profile hosted --seq 128 --runs 50
```
Priya - Content: I'll prepare two CTA variants for emails: 1) Try locally (hands-on), 2) Pilot with dedicated capacity (platform teams).
Max - Design: Posting mock hero + benchmark PNG in #design-review in 1hr. Please give rapid feedback.
June - GrowthOps: I'll add the lead-routing playbook to /marketing/playbooks/refapp-spark-routing.md and share test LP link here.
Lina - Growth Marketing: Legal note: prefacing bench numbers with the standard caveat is fine. If anything else pops up, ping Zoe. Final copy due Thu morning. Thanks team.
Priya - Content: Noted. I'll keep language minimal and link to the reproducible harness to avoid claims.
Omar - DevRel: Adding two short customer scenarios (edge device prototype, internal infra optimization) to the tutorial scripts.
Lina - Growth Marketing: Closing thread. I'll post consolidated checklist + timeline tomorrow and add the campaign folder path. :rocket:
